title: Christmas at First & Calvary
seo_title: Christmas at First & Calvary in Springfield, MO
description: Christmas at First & Calvary is a Christmas Eve worship gathering with music, Christmas carols, and prayer to celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ. The 4:00 PM family-friendly service has interactive elements for children, carols with a string quintet, and Silent Night sung by candlelight; the church describes two Christmas Eve services, and the event runs until 9:00 PM. It takes place Thursday, December 24, 2026, at First & Calvary Presbyterian Church, 820 E Cherry St in Springfield, MO.
